convert_gpt2_tf_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow GPT2 checkpoint to a PyTorch model with optional config file
load_tf_weights_in_gpt2: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch GPT2 model
run_gpt2_conversion_cli: run the GPT2 TF-to-PyTorch conversion script via argparse CLI with checkpoint and output paths
build_gpt2_model_with_tf_weights: build a GPT2Model from a config and initialize its weights from a TensorFlow checkpoint
save_pytorch_gpt2_weights: save PyTorch GPT2 model state dict and config JSON to an output directory
